observations: Photo 0 is one dark, low resolution shot of a used petrol engine, out of a car, with the cooling fan, belts, alternator and intake pipe still attached.
A Toyota emblem is legible on the black valve cover in photo 0.
There is lettering on the valve cover and a small yellow sticker near its lower edge, but the engine code cannot be read with confidence at this resolution.
A power steering pump reservoir and many hoses are attached; fan blades look intact.
The engine looks dusty but not visibly broken from this one angle; the block, sump, exhaust side and engine number are not shown.
A watermark name is printed across the image and the phone camera stamp 'CAMON 40' shows at the bottom.
Only one photo, taken from the top front.

identity.kind: used Toyota petrol engine, complete with ancillaries
read_from: photo 0 valve cover emblem for brand; engine code not legible

claims.evidence: Origin cannot be shown by one photo of the engine.
Photo 0 shows a dusty used engine with worn hoses and fittings, not a like-new unit.
Cannot be proven from photos; seals and bolt marks would only partly help.
No clip of the engine running; one still photo only.
No receipt or warranty document is shown.

risks.risk: Engine code unknown; the code sets both the price and which vehicle it fits
risks.proof: A sharp, well lit close up of the engine code on the block or the valve cover label, plus the stamped engine number
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced; identity is the price driver

risks.risk: Engine may not run, or may knock, smoke or have low compression
risks.proof: A clip of the engine running on a stand or in a car, from cold start, with sound

risks.risk: Cracked block, damaged sump or missing parts on the unseen sides
risks.proof: Photos of both sides, the sump and the rear of the block
risks.if_unproven: as a damaged core with parts missing

risks.risk: Oil and coolant contamination (blown head gasket)
risks.proof: A photo of the dipstick and the underside of the oil filler cap

risks.risk: Guarantee terms may not be honoured
risks.proof: A photo of the written guarantee with the seller's name and the engine number

proof_requests: A sharp close up of the engine code and the stamped engine number on the block
A clip of the engine running from cold start with sound
Photos of both sides, the sump and the rear of the engine
A photo of the dipstick and the underside of the oil filler cap
A photo of the engine with a handwritten note of today's date
response.reason: The Toyota emblem is legible but the engine code is not, and Toyota engines span a very wide price range, so not even a worst case price is possible. A close up of the engine code and number is needed first.
